name: Local Network
description: The local network: the permission localNetwork, the picker of the system that hands the app one service of the local network without the permission, and the advertisement of a service of the app, for apps that play or work with devices on the same network.

localNetworkUsage.default: The app connects to devices on the local network.
localNetworkUsage.description: The text of the local network prompt on Apple platforms, the NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription of the Info.plist.

bonjourServices.description: The Bonjour service types that the app finds and advertises on Apple platforms, such as "_my-game._tcp", the NSBonjourServices of the Info.plist, without which the system finds and advertises no service of a type.
